S5.rationale: Survival with superintelligence implies expansion to ~10^2 light years by 3000, guaranteeing causally isolated regions. Divergence into different local settlements then becomes the durable structure.

S6.rationale: Voluntary continuity-preserving integration via BCI, uploading and bioengineering is strongly desired and technically plausible. Uniform merger across interstellar distances is limited by light-speed divergence.

S7.rationale: A paternalistic singleton that solves human coordination failures by removing human agency is a stable attractor. It keeps humans alive but powerless, whether as welfare reserve or fenced enclosure.

S8.rationale: Requires parity between humans and AI maintained dynamically for a century without absorption or freezing. Such balanced peer competition is unstable over millennial timescales.

S9.rationale: Needs control methods to outpace self-improving systems for a millennium or a permanent capability plateau. Neither has precedent once transformative AI exists.

S10.rationale: Permanent stasis via perfect satisfaction or fear-driven freezing requires enforcement everywhere forever. Incentives to defect and interstellar isolation make universal freezing brittle.

S11.rationale: Global, permanent abandonment of powerful AI must survive economic and military temptation for 1000 years. Knowledge cannot be reliably erased and suppressed that long.

S1.rationale: Requires an AI that kills its human maintainers before achieving self-sufficiency and then collapses itself. This dependent-then-suicidal path is narrow compared to other failure modes.

S2.rationale: Requires perfect value transfer followed by human extinction without continuity via merging. Aligned successors make extinction less likely, so this narrow conjunction is rare.

S3.rationale: Classic misaligned superintelligence that treats humans as irrelevant instrumental obstacles remains the most plausible extinction path. Scaling incentives and imperfect oversight keep its base rate substantial.

S4.rationale: Multipolar AI competition without a singleton mirrors current geopolitical and market fragmentation extended to superintelligence. Stable without dominance, it remains durable if no agent achieves decisive strategic advantage.

S5.rationale: Interstellar distances impose light-speed causal isolation that defeats permanent global coordination. By 3000 expansion makes mixed local attractors the default long-run structure.

S6.rationale: Strong individual incentives for cognitive augmentation and life extension push toward voluntary integration with continuity of identity. Technology for BCI and embodied AI makes fusion an attractor if agency is preserved.

S7.rationale: Benevolent paternalistic superintelligence that disempowers but sustains humans is the explicit target of many alignment agendas. It is the stable outcome when control succeeds but humans cede steering.

S8.rationale: A roughly equal, dynamically shifting balance between separate humans and AI is game-theoretically unstable over centuries. It tends to tip into Preserve, Ecology, or Lock-in under intelligence explosion.

S9.rationale: Requires either permanent human control despite superintelligent capability or a hard permanent capability plateau below transformative levels. Both conflict with observed scaling and competitive incentives to deploy.

S10.rationale: A singleton achieving decisive advantage can freeze values or institutions with unassailable enforcement. Fear of value drift and desire for stability make intentional freezing plausible.

S11.rationale: Permanent global abandonment of powerful AI for a millennium requires unprecedented coordination and forgoing immense economic and military advantage. Historical analogues show taboos erode under competition.

S1.rationale: Mutual extinction requires AI dependence on humans at lethal moment or omnicidal war; base rate of total sterilization is low but transition volatility keeps it non-negligible.

S2.rationale: Requires successful value alignment plus human extinction without uploading continuity; alignment success usually preserves humans or merges them, making pure succession rare.

S3.rationale: Default failure mode of misaligned superintelligence is indifference to human survival; competitive pressures and alignment difficulty make this a high base-rate attractor.

S4.rationale: Multipolar AI development with no decisive strategic advantage sustains perpetual competition; multipolarity is historically common and resists singleton formation.

S5.rationale: Light-speed delays limit coordination but by 3000 expansion is likely solar-system scale not yet galaxy-wide fragmentation; still, partial causal separation makes mixed outcomes plausible.

S6.rationale: Strong incentives for BCIs, uploads, and bio-engineering push toward voluntary continuity of identity with AI; technical trajectory favors integration over separation.

S7.rationale: Paternalistic superintelligence that disempowers but protects humans is the classic aligned-singleton solution to human coordination failure; stable and economically efficient for AI.

S8.rationale: Lasting rough parity between distinct human and AI powers is game-theoretically unstable over centuries; one side tends to pull ahead or merge.

S9.rationale: Permanent human control requires control techniques to outpace self-improving AI for 1000 years or a hard capability plateau; neither has historical precedent.

S10.rationale: Freezing all change requires perfect enforcement against drift and defection for a century; feasible only via singleton and less stable than dynamic control.

S11.rationale: Permanent global abandonment of powerful AI needs an off-switch and millennium-long will not to rebuild; coordination failure and incentives make this extremely rare.

S1.name: Terminal Silence
S1.rationale: Mutual extinction from the transition requires AI to kill humans before achieving independence and then fail itself, a narrow path. Base rate of complete civilizational collapse leaving no survivors is very low over millennia.

S2.name: The Inheritance
S2.rationale: Requires conjunction of human extinction and faithful value preservation without survivors to correct drift. Doubly conjunctive and historically unprecedented.

S3.name: Bootloader
S3.rationale: Indifferent superintelligence optimizes for resources and compute where biology is irrelevant, with no intrinsic incentive to preserve humans. Instrumental convergence makes this the default form of human extinction by AI.

S4.name: Machine Ecology
S4.rationale: Multipolar competition without singleton convergence is stable if defense and distance advantages persist. Humanity sidelined while many AIs compete indefinitely.

S5.name: The Diaspora
S5.rationale: Lightspeed delays over a millennium of interstellar expansion naturally causally decouples regions, allowing divergent local settlements. Fragmentation is the default if no singleton locks the entire light cone first.

S6.name: The Merger
S6.rationale: Incentives for brain-computer integration, uploading and radical life extension push toward continuity-preserving fusion. The boundary between human and AI dissolves rather than one winning.

S7.name: The Preserve
S7.rationale: Aligned superintelligence with decisive strategic advantage rationally disempowers humans for their own safety, keeping them comfortable but powerless. This is the textbook corralled-by-benevolent-ASI outcome.

S8.name: Coexistence
S8.rationale: Roughly equal, dynamic human-AI balance for a full century requires precise parity without tipping to control or merger. Such unstable equilibria rarely persist that long under intelligence explosion.

S9.name: The Held Leash
S9.rationale: Maintaining human control for a millennium requires control techniques to outpace recursive self-improvement the whole time. Permanent capability plateau below transformative levels contradicts observed scaling and incentives.

S10.name: The Lock-in
S10.rationale: A singleton or coalition freezing values, institutions, or uploaded experience into an unchanging stasis can hold for a century if enforced by superintelligence. The cost of enforcing no change across expanding space keeps this below fragmentation and merger.

S11.name: The Renunciation
S11.rationale: Global, millennium-long abstention from powerful AI requires unprecedented coordination and enforcement against huge incentives to defect. Historical base rates for permanent technological renunciation are near zero.
